name: Drag and drop
plain: Lets people drag items within or into the page, and lets the page start drags.
meaning: A site can start a drag with text, links or files, and react when people drop things on it. Data in a drag is readable only on drop, so the page cannot spy on a drag it does not own.

web.api: dragstart, dragover, drop events; DataTransfer; draggable=true

access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
access.iframe: Dragging across iframes allowed; dropped data readable only in the drop handler
steps: Person drags an item over the page
dragover must call preventDefault to accept

limits.headline: Can let you drag items on the page, or drop files onto it
limits.user_action: You drag a file, text or picture onto the page, or drag an item inside it.
can: Accept files you drop onto the page, such as photos or documents
Let you rearrange items by dragging, like cards or lists
Start a drag so you can pull text or an image out of the page
cannot: See your files before you drop them
See files you did not drop
Browse your folders on its own
Take over dragging from other apps or windows

story.what_it_is: People can drag things around the page, or drop files onto it.

marketing.name: HTML Drag and Drop API
marketing.pitch: MDN explains that pages can make items draggable and react when you drop files or text on them.

story.for_you: You pick up a card, a file or a photo with your mouse or finger and drop it somewhere else. It feels natural, so you rarely think about it.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to make web apps feel like real software: reordering lists, uploading by dropping a file, building layouts. It also boosts upload completion because dropping is easier than browsing folders.

use_cases.example: You drag a task card from To Do to Done in a project board.
You drop a photo onto a design canvas and it appears where you let go.
You drag pieces on a browser puzzle or card game, like moving a card in solitaire.
You drag a file into a chat window to send it.
You drag songs into a playlist order on a web music player.
You drag a product into a wish list or onto a compare bar.

risks: Dropped files read by the page

technical_bounds: dataTransfer is in protected mode outside drop: types are visible, data is not readable until drop
Cannot start an OS file drag from the page except the Chrome only DownloadURL type trick
Dropped files expose name, size, type, lastModified; no full path
Touch support: iOS Safari 11 (iPad and iPhone); Android Chrome supports long-press drag since Chrome 96 on some devices
Drag image limited to a rendered element or image; size capped by the OS

abuse: Exfil of dropped sensitive files into the wrong site

history.change: Touch drag and drop on iOS 11 and iPadOS

refs.label: MDN HTML Drag and Drop API
